t2.thesis: RDDT enters a priced-for-a-big-move print (about 13% implied) after a sharp pre-earnings sell-off, which roughly offsets the usual positive drift, leaving a near-coin-flip with a slight upward lean.
reasons: The stock fell about 9% in the past week and sits roughly 48% below its 52-week high, so expectations are already reset lower, which helps a beat-and-raise reaction
Fundamentals are strong: 61% revenue growth, a 29% operating margin, and EPS estimates revised up about 5% over 90 days
Q3 guidance of $860-870M implies a growth slowdown, and US DAUq growth is only 6%; headlines flag slower-growth fears
The last print dropped 18% despite a 30% EPS beat, so beats alone do not secure a rise, though 3 of the last 4 reactions were positive
Implied move of 13% against a 3x IV/RV ratio means the options are expensive; this adds variance but no clear direction
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance relative to the roughly 55% growth the market expects, together with US DAUq trends and ad pricing.

prior.from: I3 buy-everything hit rate: overall validation 54.2%, AMC 53.8%, software_internet cluster 54.1%

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today's date is 2026-10-28, so that earnings report on 2026-10-29 hasn't happened yet, and I have no information about how RDDT's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 2 points from 0.54: the post-July selloff and slowing-growth narrative offset the oversold-bounce and positive-revision signals.

theses.expected: Rise: a beat plus Q4 guidance above consensus triggers a relief rally from depressed levels
theses.mechanism: Sentiment is washed out, short interest is 15% of float, and forward P/E is about 14, so a good guide can force short covering and a re-rating
theses.wrong_if: Q4 revenue guidance implies growth below roughly 50% or the midpoint is below consensus

theses.expected: Fall: guidance confirms a deceleration and US user growth stalls
theses.mechanism: A high-multiple growth stock is sold when the growth trajectory bends, as happened after the July print despite a big beat
theses.wrong_if: US DAUq re-accelerates and guidance exceeds the street

theses.expected: Flat or small move with the open-to-open outcome decided by overnight noise
theses.mechanism: The pre-earnings drop already priced in much of the slowdown, so an in-line print leaves limited reaction
theses.wrong_if: The gap at the open exceeds roughly 5% in either direction

key_observations: Q4 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance versus consensus
US DAUq growth and logged-in trend, plus search-algorithm commentary
Q3 revenue growth versus 60%, and the ninth consecutive quarter above 60%
